comments.body: Hi @pcbeingused333 thank for this PR it look good - In order to accept it and merge it you will have to sign the https://neo4j.com/developer/contributing-code/#sign-cla

Hi @MacondoExpress, thanks for the review. The Neo4j CLA for this account (pcbeingused333) was already emailed to cla@neo4j.com on 2026-10-25 and cla+noreply confirmed receipt; the same signature is the one already noted on neo4j/neo4j-graphrag-python#698. `cla-check` on this pull request (2026-11-02) still fails because that GitHub login is not listed in the CLA database, which is a database entry on the Neo4j side rather than a missing signature. Could you add the login and re-run the check? If the lookup expects a different email, tell me which one and I will match it.

Disclosure: this reply was prepared with the assistance of an AI coding agent and submitted by the account owner.
